description: List the logged-in seller's delegations (resource sent to buyers): amount, TRX amount, duration, unit price, type (AUTO, MANUAL, EXTEND, FAST), status and payout. Newest first; page with `offset`/`limit`. Use for a seller's per-delegation history; for earnings totals use `tronsave_get_seller_stats`, for orders the user bought use `tronsave_list_orders` (`isOnlyMyOrder`). Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only.

filterByResourceType.description: Only ENERGY or only BANDWIDTH delegations; omit for both.

filterByTypeDelegate.description: Only this delegation type: AUTO (auto-sell pool), MANUAL (`tronsave_sell_order_manual`), EXTEND (extensions), FAST (fast orders). Omit for all.

offset.description: Number of delegations to skip for pagination (default 0); add `limit` to page forward.

timeFilterBy.description: Time window: All, last 7 days (D7) or last 30 days (D30). Default All.

name: tronsave_list_delegations
title: Delegation History
